claims.claim: EV lithium-ion battery pack costs were around $1,355/kWh in 2008 and declined 89% by 2022 (to $153/kWh), consistent with a ~$1,000/kWh prevailing price in the early 2010s.
claims.episode_span: the prevailing price for an automotive-grade lithium-ion pack hovered near one thousand dollars per kilowatt-hour
claims.source_title: FOTW #1272: Electric Vehicle Battery Pack Costs in 2022 Are Nearly 90% Lower than in 2008 - US Department of Energy
claims.supporting_quote: The 2022 estimate is $153/kWh on a usable-energy basis for production at scale of at least 100,000 units per year. That compares to $1,355/kWh in 2008.

claims.claim: Lithium-ion battery pack prices fell to a record-low average of $115/kWh in 2024, matching the digest's $100-150/kWh mid-2020s figure.
claims.episode_span: pack prices approaching one hundred to one hundred fifty dollars per kilowatt-hour at the leading factories, an order-of-magnitude reduction from the 2010 baseline
claims.source_title: Lithium-Ion Battery Pack Prices See Largest Drop Since 2017, Falling to $115 per Kilowatt-Hour - BloombergNEF
claims.supporting_quote: Lithium-ion battery pack prices dropped 20% from 2023 to a record low of $115 per kilowatt-hour, according to analysis by research provider BloombergNEF (BNEF).

claims.claim: Adoption of lower-cost lithium-iron-phosphate (LFP) batteries is one of the factors driving battery pack price declines.
claims.episode_span: cathode chemistry moved away from high-cobalt NMC formulations toward lower-cobalt or cobalt-free LFP variants
claims.source_title: Lithium-Ion Battery Pack Prices See Largest Drop Since 2017, Falling to $115 per Kilowatt-Hour - BloombergNEF
claims.supporting_quote: Factors driving the decline include cell manufacturing overcapacity, economies of scale, low metal and component prices, adoption of lower-cost lithium-iron-phosphate (LFP) batteries, and a slowdown in electric vehicle sales growth.

claims.claim: LFP batteries contain no cobalt and have lower specific energy than NMC/NCA chemistries - the energy-density trade-off the digest describes.
claims.episode_span: accepting a modest energy-density trade-off that was later offset by larger cell formats
claims.supporting_quote: The specific energy of LFP batteries is lower than that of other common lithium-ion battery types such as nickel manganese cobalt (NMC) and nickel cobalt aluminum (NCA)

claims.claim: EV cell formats evolved through 2170 cells to structural battery packs using 4680 cells (e.g. Tesla Model Y), supporting the digest's format-evolution and structural-pack claims.
claims.episode_span: cell format evolved from small cylindrical 18650 cells to 2170 and then 4680 formats
claims.supporting_quote: Model Y vehicles have been produced with several cell formats over the vehicle's life, including 2170 cells, prismatic LFP cells in China-built standard-range cars, and structural battery packs using 4680 cells in some Texas-built vehicles.
